commands.collection:
"""Operator-only collection in the disposable evaluation VM."""
import base64
import datetime
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import time

APP = Path('/vercel/evaluation/rea')
OUT = Path('/vercel/output')
ROOT = Path('/var/lib/rea-controller')
done = json.loads((OUT/'rr-final-validation.done.json').read_text())
assert done == {'janitorExit':0,'retentionExit':0,'catalogueExit':0,'negativeGateExit':1}, done
catalogue = json.loads((OUT/'controller-accepted-final.json').read_text())
jr = json.loads((OUT/'janitor-acceptance.json').read_text())
rr = json.loads((OUT/'retention-acceptance.json').read_text())
negative = json.loads((OUT/'controller-negative-gate.json').read_text())
assert catalogue['summary'] == {'PASS':20,'FAIL':0,'NOT_TESTED':8}
assert jr['summary'] == {'PASS':12,'FAIL':0,'NOT_TESTED':0}
assert rr['summary'] == {'PASS':4,'FAIL':0,'NOT_TESTED':0}
assert [c['status'] for c in jr['cases'] if c['id']=='JR-09'] == ['PASS']
assert (Path(negative['statePath'])/'launch-counter').read_text() == '0'

def processes():
    found=[]
    names=[str(APP/'experiments/execution-controller'/n).encode() for n in ['controller.py','worker.py']]
    for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not p.name.isdecimal():continue
        try:
            args=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
            if any(n in args for n in names):found.append(int(p.name))
        except OSError:pass
    return found

until=time.monotonic()+35
while processes() and time.monotonic()<until:time.sleep(0.2)
remaining=processes()
assert not remaining,remaining
groups=[str(p) for p in Path('/sys/fs/cgroup').glob('rea-eval-*')]
assert not groups,groups
mounts=[s.split()[4] for s in Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines() if s.split()[4].startswith(str(ROOT))]
assert not mounts,mounts
uid_workers=[]
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
    if not p.name.isdecimal():continue
    try:
        if (p/'status').stat().st_uid==1001:uid_workers.append(int(p.name))
    except OSError:pass
assert not uid_workers,uid_workers
stores=[]
for state in sorted(ROOT.iterdir()):
    if not state.is_dir() or not (state/'state.db').exists():continue
    with sqlite3.connect(f'file:{state}/state.db?mode=ro',uri=True) as db:
        rows={t:db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM '+t).fetchone()[0] for t in ['requests','decisions','audit']}
    runs=list((state/'runs').iterdir())
    leases=list((state/'leases').iterdir())
    metrics=list(state.glob('*.metrics.json'))
    assert not any(rows.values()),(str(state),rows)
    assert not runs and not leases and not metrics,str(state)
    diagnostics=[]
    for name in ['server.log','restart.log','janitor.log','guardian.log']:
        p=state/name
        if p.exists():diagnostics.append({'name':name,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    stores.append({'state':str(state),'rowsAfterAutomaticExpiry':rows,
                   'rawRunHandles':0,'leases':0,'metrics':0,
                   'privateDiagnosticHandles':diagnostics})
source={str(p.relative_to(APP)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for p in sorted((APP/'experiments/execution-controller').iterdir()) if p.is_file()}
for name in ['package.json','package-lock.json','LICENSE']:
    source[name]=hashlib.sha256((APP/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--','src','tests','.github','package.json','package-lock.json','LICENSE'],cwd=APP,text=True)==''
debug=OUT/'controller-private-debug.log'
debug_existed=debug.exists();debug.unlink(missing_ok=True)
registry_hash=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'registry.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
shutil.rmtree(ROOT)
sockets=[Path('/run/rea-controller.sock'),*Path('/run').glob('rea-jr-*.sock')]
for p in sockets:p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
Path('/run/rea-evaluation-vm').unlink(missing_ok=True)
assert not ROOT.exists() and not any(p.exists() for p in sockets) and not debug.exists()
trials=[]
for name in ['janitor-initial','retention-initial','janitor-before-settlement-fix','retention-before-settlement-fix','catalogue-before-settlement-fix']:
    p=OUT/(name+'.json')
    if p.exists():
        d=json.loads(p.read_text())
        trials.append({'name':name,'summary':d['summary'],'failures':[
            {'id':c['id'],'errorType':c.get('errorType'),'diagnostic':c.get('diagnostic')} for c in d['cases'] if c['status']=='FAIL']})
record={
    'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'baseline':catalogue['baseline'],'catalogue':catalogue,'janitorRegressions':jr,'retentionRecovery':rr,
    'checks':{'finalExits':done,'pythonCompile':'PASS, five Python source files',
        'format':(OUT/'controller-format-check.log').read_text(),'lint':(OUT/'controller-lint.log').read_text(),
        'parentBuildExit':(OUT/'build.exit').read_text().strip(),
        'negativeDriverGate':{'expectedExit':1,'actualExit':1,'actualReaLaunches':0}},
    'logs':{'catalogue':(OUT/'controller-acceptance-final.log').read_text(),
            'janitor':(OUT/'janitor-acceptance.log').read_text(),
            'retention':(OUT/'retention-acceptance.log').read_text(),
            'parentBuild':(OUT/'build.log').read_text()},
    'developmentTrials':trials,'sourceSha256':source,'registrySha256':registry_hash,
    'outerCgroupMetrics':{n:Path('/sys/fs/cgroup',n).read_text() for n in ['memory.max','memory.peak','memory.events','pids.max','pids.peak','cpu.stat']},
    'disposal':{'processes':remaining,'uid1001Processes':uid_workers,'ownedCgroups':groups,'ownedMounts':mounts,
        'storesAfterAutomaticExpiryBeforeOperatorRemoval':stores,'privateRootRemoved':not ROOT.exists(),
        'socketHandlesRemoved':len(sockets),'diagnosticCopyWasPresent':debug_existed,'diagnosticCopyRemoved':not debug.exists(),
        'scope':'Rows/raw run handles/leases/metrics expired automatically after recovery. Operator then removed empty control containers, private diagnostics and sockets. No physical erasure/unknown-backup claim.'},
    'verdict':{'JR_09':'PASS_FOR_TESTED_PRIMARY_LOSS_SEQUENCE','singleGuardLoss':'PASS_FOR_RR_01_03',
        'forcedDeletionFault':'FAILED_AT_DEADLINE_BLOCKED_OWNERSHIP_RETAINED_RECOVERED_LATE',
        'REA_1_1':'PARTIAL','productionAndUnrestrictedAgents':'NO_GO','bothGuardLoss':'NOT_TESTED',
        'hungGuard':'NOT_TESTED','clockUncertainty':'NOT_TESTED','fullSCA':'NOT_TESTED','nativeProviders':'NOT_TESTED',
        'humanReview':'NOT_ATTESTED','realCredentials':'NOT_COLLECTED','mainChanged':False,'platformIntegration':False}}
raw=json.dumps(record,indent=2).encode()
(OUT/'retention-export.json').write_bytes(raw)
compressed=gzip.compress(raw)
(OUT/'retention-export.gz').write_bytes(compressed)
b64=base64.b64encode(compressed).decode()
(OUT/'retention-export.b64').write_text(b64)
print(json.dumps({'bytes':len(raw),'gzipSha256':hashlib.sha256(compressed).hexdigest(),
    'base64Characters':len(b64),'chunks':(len(b64)+1799)//1800,'catalogue':catalogue['summary'],
    'janitor':jr['summary'],'retention':rr['summary'],'stores':len(stores),'sourceHashes':len(source)},indent=2))
